correctness.rationale: The \(q\)-rooted forest partition determinant on \(K_{a,b}\) has spectral factors \(q(q+N)(q+a)^{b-1}(q+b)^{a-1}\), giving independent Bernoulli root indicators. For one balancing step, match \(a-1\) complementary Bernoulli pairs and \(b-a\) singles. Each complementary pair has coefficients \((ab,qN,q^2)\) versus \(((a+1)(b-1),qN,q^2)\) and is ordered in likelihood ratio, while the singleton parameters strictly decrease. Likelihood-ratio order is preserved by convolution with the other Poisson-binomial summands because those summands are log-concave. Strict all-threshold domination follows from one strict Bernoulli difference and full interval support. The mean gap is an exact algebraic identity. Direct forest enumeration and exact-rational inequalities passed 46928 checker assertions for small/medium examples; the written proof covers arbitrary \(N\) and real \(q>0\).

originality.rationale: The claim is the all-positive-fugacity, fixed-total-order likelihood-ratio ordering of rooted-forest component counts under a bipartition-balancing move. Prior sources give the rooted matrix-forest determinant, prescribed-root enumeration, qualitative monotonicity in fugacity, and asymptotic Laplacian coefficient laws, but the inspected material does not establish comparison of different complete-bipartite graphs in likelihood-ratio order. Published mathematical-record searches returned different invariants or balancing results. The substantive residual risk is undiscovered older derivations combining the known enumeration with total positivity; priority is not independently certified.

value.rationale: Random rooted forest intensity \(q\) governs multiscale network cluster counts. Changing complete bipartite part sizes at fixed total order moves individual root-count Bernoulli parameters in opposite directions, making stochastic comparison nontrivial. The explicit factor matching establishes the stronger likelihood-ratio order simultaneously at every root fugacity and hence ranks every upper tail and increasing statistic, with unique extremal bipartitions and a strict exact mean difference. This is a motivated structural result rather than a re-enumeration or a single moment.
